name: openfray.app
description: The deploy that ties the OpenFray console, website, and handbook into one site.

scripts.dev:all: npm run dev -w console & npm run dev -w site & npm run dev -w docs & wait
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && node scripts/check-news-slugs.mjs && node scripts/check-prose.mjs && npm run build -w console && npm run build -w site && npm run build -w docs && node scripts/assemble-site.mjs && node scripts/check-spacing.mjs && node scripts/check-css-specificity.mjs
scripts.test: vitest run && npm run test -w console && npm run test -w site
